name: Path of the Wild Heart

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A barbarian bonded to beasts, whose Rage takes the shape of the bear, the eagle or the wolf.

feature.name: Animal Speaker
feature.summary: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, only as Rituals, using Wisdom.
feature.text: You can cast the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.

feature.name: Rage of the Wilds
feature.summary: Each time you rage choose Bear (resist almost everything), Eagle (Dash and Disengage) or Wolf (allies gain Advantage near you).
feature.text: Whenever you enter your Rage, choose one of these options; it lasts while the Rage does. Bear: you also have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant. Eagle: when you enter the Rage you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of that Bonus Action, and while raging you can take both as a single Bonus Action. Wolf: your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy of yours within 5 feet of you.

feature.name: Aspect of the Wilds
feature.summary: Choose Owl (Darkvision), Panther (Climb Speed) or Salmon (Swim Speed); you can change it after a Long Rest.
feature.text: Choose one of these options; you can change the choice whenever you finish a Long Rest. Owl: you gain Darkvision out to 60 feet, or your Darkvision reaches 60 feet farther if you already have it. Panther: you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Salmon: you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Owl
options.summary: Darkvision 60 feet, or 60 feet more if you already have it.

options.name: Panther
options.summary: A Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Salmon
options.summary: A Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feature.name: Nature Speaker
feature.summary: Cast Commune with Nature, only as a Ritual, using Wisdom.

feature.name: Power of the Wilds
feature.summary: While raging choose Falcon (fly), Lion (nearby enemies have Disadvantage against others) or Ram (knock Large or smaller creatures Prone).
